new_libraries.name: quickMap
new_libraries.author: Holman Buenaventura <habuenav@hotmail.com>
new_libraries.sentence: An ultra-fast and versatile alternative to Arduino's map() function using floats.
new_libraries.paragraph: Designed for critical performance in audio systems, synthesis, and high-speed sensor reading. Precalculates slope and offset to eliminate runtime splits. Supports inverted ranges and automatic constraints.
